environmentVariables.description: Air France-KLM API key; unlocks that airline's live fares/award search. Optional, trvl works without it.

environmentVariables.description: Session cookies for Air France-KLM award search. Optional, unlocks award-fare lookups only.

tools.name: choose_github_agent_decision
tools.returns: Exact paid tool, price, sample, and required input without a verdict

tools.returns: AVOID, CAUTION, or VIABLE with evidence and reuse guidance

tools.returns: READY, REVIEW, or REPAIR with commit-pinned findings
tools.task: Audit coding-agent repository instructions

tools.returns: Root-cause verdict, redacted evidence, and next actions

tools.name: classify_github_actions_flake
tools.returns: Flake verdict and ONCE, NO, or NOT_NEEDED retry action
tools.task: Decide whether to retry once or fix

tools.name: check_mcp_tool_drift
tools.returns: Compatibility verdict, accept or block action, and exact hashes
tools.task: Detect breaking MCP tool-catalog changes

useCases: Choose the exact decision tool from a bounded GitHub engineering task category for free
Check one public GitHub bounty before coding
Rank 2-10 public GitHub bounty opportunities
